encoding.unicode: all identity strings must already be NFC; reject rather than normalize
encoding.whitespace: identity strings must be nonempty and have no leading or trailing whitespace; reject rather than trim
encoding.canonical_json: serde_json::to_vec of the explicitly declared Rust structs below; struct field order is the serialization order; no maps, floats, omitted defaults, or trailing newline

world_id.meaning: content identity of the exact generator-sampled latent world, shared by its intervention siblings
world_id.source_object: the actual jev_decision_world_v01::Episode fields template.template_id, sampled_world, provenance.world_sample_seed

root_id.meaning: content identity of the pre-variant neighborhood root, shared by its A/F/S/N siblings and distinct from world_id
root_id.source_object: the actual generator Triplet root context before episode variants: partition namespace, family slug, sequence, seed, anchor_id, template id, and context code

episode_id.meaning: generator-owned episode identity emitted by the actual episode object
episode_id.canonicalization: exact validated string, no aliasing or reconstruction

full_rendered_input_hash.meaning: identity of the exact model-visible rendered text bytes
full_rendered_input_hash.source_object: Episode.renderings[0].text, required byte-equal to the canonical episode content consumed by the frozen encoder
full_rendered_input_hash.canonicalization: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes; no trimming, normalization, prefix, or wrapper

selector_input_hash.meaning: identity of the exact generator occurrence-selection request used to resolve one role from the built neighborhood
selector_input_hash.source_object: typed OccurrenceSelectorInput passed to the R1 select_occurrence routine that selects the actual episode object before writing its occurrence
selector_input_hash.canonicalization: SHA-256 of canonical_json(payload); this is the pre-feature occurrence selector, not the later radius matcher

occurrence_selector.operation: select exactly one generator-produced episode by its declared role from the current Triplet; fail if role is absent or duplicated
occurrence_selector.candidate_order_sha256: SHA-256(canonical_json(ordered candidate_semantic_id strings read from the actual anchor episode runtime schema))
validated_fields: role must occur exactly once in the Triplet
candidate_order_sha256 must match the selected episode runtime schema

sidecar.emission_point: after the exact episode object and render are constructed and validated, and in the same write transaction as its corresponding corpus/panel occurrence
sidecar.targets_features_predictions_metrics: never serialized to the identity sidecar
